note: Test reply: he rides post from Vienna to Glogau, on the road from the first day, there on the 26th. A letter catches him on the road. Illustrative.

reports.title: A note on the road
reports.text: A line to find you on the road: the Conference has asked after you twice.

reports.title: The works at Glogau
reports.text: The ramparts want turf and the palisades on the covered way are rotten in places. I have set the garrison to it.

hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: the journey to Glogau.

decisions.knows: The Emperor is dead; Vienna is in mourning and short of money.
decisions.decides: Keeps his counsel and orders the regiments readied, quietly.

changes.title: At Glogau
changes.briefing: Five days on the post road brought you to Glogau on the 26th. Wallis shows you the works.

dossier.note: Wrote of “A note on the road”.
